customers.evidence: Provide the world’s best customer experience every day.

employees.evidence: We view each other as colleagues – part of the same team

dei.evidence: We are a diverse and inclusive company

community.evidence: We aim to make a difference in the communities where we work and live.

integrity.evidence: We earn that trust by ensuring everything we do is reliable, consistent, and with the highest level of integrity.

innovation.evidence: From our innovative products to our world-class customer service

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, customer-first framing built on seven named values, each a bold headline with first-person plural voice. Absolute language such as best, every day, and unparalleled dominates. Commitments are stated firmly rather than hedged. Employees and diversity appear as values, while environment, shareholders and safety are absent. Wording is promotional and emotive.
